items.title: TCI Express Targets Logistics Expansion with INR 500 Crore Investment Over Five Years
items.snippet: With an investment of INR 500 crore spread out over five years, TCI Express intends to fortify its pan-India delivery network. In Ahmedabad, Lucknow, and Kolkata, the business would add almost 4 lakh sq ft of operational area by establishing three sorting centers.

items.title: Mufin Green Finance to Buy 23% Stake in BimaPay Through INR 66 Crore Deal
items.snippet: Mufin Green Finance has approved the acquisition of up to 23% ownership in fintech insurtech company BimaPay Finsure for INR 65.75 crore in an all-cash agreement.
